evidence.title: Yotta Data Services nears IPO, says chairman Hiranandani

summary: Yotta Data Services, a company that provides AI-driven data management and analytics solutions, is preparing to launch an initial public offering, according to chairman Hiranandani. The IPO is expected to raise capital to expand its AI infrastructure and accelerate growth in the data services market.
title: Yotta Data Services Nears IPO, Chairman Hiranandani Announces
